import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    # Extract the source dataframe
    df = inputs["meter_reads"].copy()
    
    # Step 1: Sort by meter_id ASC, read_ts ASC, read_seq ASC
    df = df.sort_values(by=["meter_id", "read_ts", "read_seq"], ascending=[True, True, True])
    
    # Step 2: Dedup - keep LAST row per meter_id
    # Drop duplicates keeping the last occurrence of each meter_id
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["meter_id"], keep="last")
    
    # Step 3: Aggregate by zone
    # Group by zone (treating NULL as a real group) and compute aggregations
    agg_result = df.groupby("zone", as_index=False, dropna=False).agg(
        total_kwh=("kwh", "sum"),
        meter_count=("meter_id", "count")
    )
    
    # Rename to match expected output columns
    agg_result = agg_result[["zone", "total_kwh", "meter_count"]]
    
    return {"zone_totals": agg_result}
